name: Hannah
source:
[url=/c176077]Christine[/url] is immediately struck by Hannah’s complexity—intelligent, beautiful, yet deeply bitter about her condition. As the story unfolds, the two women grow closer, forging a connection that might transform both of their lives. Will Christine be the one to help Hannah find new hope, or will Hannah end up changing Christine in ways she never expected?

[From [url=https://winter-wolves.itch.io/christinecare]itch.io[/url]]
